text: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
reflection: Worry asks you to carry tomorrow alone. Prayer hands it back to the One who already holds it.

text: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
reflection: You don't have to carry your worries alone. God cares for you and invites you to give Him everything that feels heavy.

text: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
reflection: Today has enough grace for today. Let tomorrow wait until it arrives.

text: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
reflection: Fear shrinks when you remember who stands beside you. You are held, helped and upheld.

text: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
reflection: His peace doesn't depend on calm circumstances. It is a gift you can receive even in the storm.

text: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
reflection: Trust isn't the absence of fear. It's choosing where to turn when fear comes.

text: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
reflection: Fear is not your inheritance. Power, love and a steady mind are already yours.

text: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
reflection: Stillness is not doing nothing. It is resting in the truth that God is in control.

text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
reflection: The invitation is simple: come as you are, tired and heavy, and receive rest.

text: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
reflection: What feels too heavy for you is never too heavy for Him. Let Him sustain you today.

text: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
reflection: Where your mind rests, your heart follows. Fix your thoughts on Him and find peace.

text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
reflection: When your thoughts race, His comfort meets you right in the middle of them.

text: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
reflection: Your pain doesn't push God away. He draws closest when your heart is breaking.

text: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
reflection: Healing may be slow, but it is certain. He tends every wound with care.

text: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.
reflection: Every tear is seen, and one day every tear will be wiped away. Sorrow does not have the last word.

text: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
reflection: Night feels long, but it always ends. Morning and joy are on their way.

text: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
reflection: Grief is not a sign of weak faith. It is a place where God's comfort is promised.

text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
reflection: It's okay to be honest about a heavy heart, and then to speak hope to it.

text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
reflection: Even when the road is unclear, God's thoughts toward you are good, and your story has a hopeful end.

text: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
reflection: Hope isn't something you have to manufacture. The God of hope fills you until it overflows.

text: It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
reflection: Yesterday's failures don't define today. His mercy is fresh every single morning.

text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
reflection: Not everything is good, but God is weaving even the hard things into something good.

text: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
reflection: Faith holds on to what God has promised, even before you can see it.

text: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
reflection: Waiting on God isn't wasted time. It's where tired hearts are renewed.

text: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
reflection: Your strength may run out, but His never does. Lean on Him for what's in front of you.

text: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
reflection: Courage comes from company. Wherever you go today, you do not go alone.

text: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness.
reflection: Your weakness is not a barrier to God. It's the very place His strength shows up.

text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
reflection: Help isn't far off or delayed. In trouble, God is present right now.

text: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
reflection: Look up. The One who made the mountains is the One who helps you.

text: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
reflection: God is already ahead of you on the road you're afraid to walk.

text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
reflection: You don't need the whole map. Trust Him with the next step, and He will direct the path.

text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
reflection: A shepherd leads, protects and provides. You are cared for, even when you feel lost.

text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
reflection: A lamp lights the next few steps, not the whole journey. That's enough to keep walking.

text: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.
reflection: When you don't know which way to turn, listen. God still guides those who seek Him.

text: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
reflection: Feeling lost doesn't put you out of reach. You are exactly who Jesus came looking for.

text: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
reflection: God doesn't just point the way. He walks with you and teaches you as you go.

text: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
reflection: Gratitude doesn't wait for perfect days. It finds God's goodness in every one.

text: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
reflection: His goodness isn't seasonal. His mercy lasts forever, and that's always worth thanks.

text: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
reflection: Today is a gift, made on purpose. Receive it with gladness.

text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
reflection: Every good thing in your life traces back to a generous Father who never changes.

text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
reflection: Peace and thankfulness grow together. Let both settle into your heart today.

text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
reflection: Thanksgiving is the doorway into God's presence. Start with thanks and see where it leads.

text: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
reflection: Joy in the Lord doesn't depend on circumstances. It's rooted in who He is.

text: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
reflection: The fullest joy isn't found in what you have, but in whose presence you're in.

text: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
reflection: Jesus wants your joy to be full, not partial or passing, but lasting.

text: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
reflection: Imagine it: God rejoices over you with singing. You are deeply delighted in.

text: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
reflection: Take a moment to remember what God has already done. Gladness follows remembering.
